name: Wrattonbully

climate: Seasons this warm ripen Chardonnay, Merlot, Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon and Sauvignon Blanc fully without cooking off their freshness.
Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Merlot and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

soil.rock: Sand is warm and airy. It drains fast but holds little water, and phylloxera does not thrive in it. Clay holds water well but drains poorly. It stays cool, which slows ripening and keeps acidity up.
soil.top: The topsoil stores water through dry spells, but stays wet and cold after rain, which slows ripening and can swell the grapes. Its high pH can starve vines of iron and yellow the leaves, so growers plant lime-tolerant rootstocks.

land: Mostly flat. Easy and cheap to farm by machine, but on still nights cold air settles on flat ground, so spring frost is a bigger risk.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
